title: Student Visa
shortDescription: Pursue your higher education dreams at world-class global universities with expert guidance.
description: Pursuing higher education abroad is a dream for many students who aspire to build successful careers, gain international exposure, and experience diverse cultures. A student visa is the key document that allows you to study legally in your chosen country while opening doors to world-class education and global opportunities
features: Access to World-Class Education – Study at top-ranked universities and colleges worldwide.
Work Opportunities – Many countries allow part-time work during studies and full-time work during breaks.
Post-Study Pathways – Several nations offer post-study work visas, paving the way for career growth and permanent residency options.
Cultural Exposure – Live and interact in a multicultural environment, enhancing both academic and personal growth
eligibility: Valid passport with at least 6 months validity
Academic credentials with required percentage/GPA
Proof of English proficiency (IELTS/PTE/TOEFL/Duolingo)
Acceptance letter/Offer letter from a recognized overseas institution
Adequate financial funds for tuition and living expenses

title: Permanent Residency Visa
shortDescription: Settle permanently in top destination countries like Canada, Australia, and New Zealand with your family.
description: Permanent Residency (PR) grants you the legal right to live, work, and study anywhere in your chosen destination country indefinitely, along with access to subsidized healthcare, free child education, and a direct pathway to citizenship. Quantum Overseas specializes in Express Entry, PNP streams, SkillSelect GSM, and State Sponsorship programs.
features: Educational Credential Assessment (ECA) / Skills Assessment Assistance
Express Entry Profile Creation & PNP State Nominations
Complete PR Dossier Preparation & Police Clearance/Medical Guidance
eligibility: Age between 18 to 45 years
Recognized bachelor's degree or higher
Minimum 1-3 years of skilled work experience
Required score in language tests (IELTS / CELPIP / PTE)
Proof of settlement funds for you and dependents

processSteps.title: Points Assessment
processSteps.description: Evaluation of age, qualification, experience, and language proficiency.
